competitions.name: Asian Para Games 2026, Aichi-Nagoya
competitions.note: 5th Asian Para Games, Aichi-Nagoya (18–24 Oct). India's medals on 19 Oct: Mona Agarwal won women's 10m air rifle SH1 gold with a Games record 250.0 (Avani Lekhara silver); Nishad Kumar won men's long jump T47 gold with 7.11m (high jump T47 final on 20 Oct); Kokila won women's J2 -52kg judo silver after beating world champion Liu Yi (China) in the semi-final, losing the final by ippon in 21 seconds to Kyrgyzstan's Aibike Ulanbek Kyzy; judoka Kapil Parmar won men's J1 -70kg bronze. Sonalben Patel (women's singles C3) and Prachi Pandey (Class 6) are assured of para table tennis medals (semi-finals 20 Oct); Nitesh Kumar/Thulasimathi Murugesan are assured of a para badminton mixed doubles medal; powerlifter Jaspreet Kaur finished fourth in the women's 45kg; Sheetal Devi equalled the compound ranking-round world record (704/720). Also on 19 Oct: Rinku Hooda won men's javelin F46 gold (65.11m) with Ajeet Singh Yadav silver (65.02m); Ravi Karthik Budigina won men's 100m freestyle S13 silver. Broadcast details for India not confirmed. Update 19:20 IST: India 11 medals (4 gold, 5 silver, 2 bronze), fourth behind China, Japan, Uzbekistan; in the women's 1500m, Soumya won T12/T13 gold with Radha Venkatesh silver, and Ravanni Valasanaini took T11 bronze. India's para coach expects about six medals on 20 Oct; Sony Sports Ten 2/3, DD Sports (free) and SonyLIV carry the Games. 20 Oct (day 3, morning): Deepthi Jeevanji won women's 400m T20 gold in a Games record 56.36s; Manish Narwal took men's 10m air pistol SH1 silver (233.7, behind Korea's Jo Jeongdu); Ashok won men's 65kg powerlifting silver (192kg, behind China's Zou Yi); Bhavina Patel, Sonalben Patel, Prachi Pandey and Baby Sahana Ravi won table tennis bronzes. India 22 medals (5G 8S 9B) by mid-morning, per TOI/NDTV/Wikipedia. Later on 20 Oct: Shrishti Arora won women's 10m air pistol SH1 bronze (Paralympic Committee of India); Sheetal Devi beat Japan's Aya Shinohara 145–137 to reach the women's compound final, assuring a medal. Around 12:30 IST: Pradeep Kumar (silver) and Ayush Verma (bronze) in men's javelin F53/54; Sheetal Devi and Payal Nag reached the women's compound doubles final (India Today). Around 13:00 IST: Sheetal Devi and Payal Nag beat Thailand 151–135 in the women's compound team semi-final (at least silver); debutant Swati Chaudhary beat Korea's Lee Eunhee 6–2 to reach the women's W1 final v China (at least silver); Jehan Madan won men's singles Class 1 table tennis bronze; Pramod Bhagat and Nitesh Kumar reached the men's SL3 badminton semi-finals (medals assured). Around 14:15 IST (ANI): Himanshu Nandal won men's 400m freestyle S11 bronze (5:10.91), India's second para-swimming medal; ANI put India on 24 medals (5G 8S 11B). Sheetal Devi and Payal Nag face China in the women's compound doubles gold-medal match on 21 Oct from 05:55 IST (SAI Media); Harvinder Singh and Vijay Sundi also reached a para-archery gold-medal match (The News Mill). Later on 20 Oct (Livemint): Pranav Soorma won men's discus F51/52/53 gold with an Asian record 11.66m (Ram Ratan Singh silver); Simran Sharma won women's 200m T12 gold in a Games record 24.80s (Tejalben Damor bronze); Preeti Pal won women's 200m T35 silver; Niranjan Mukundan won men's 200m IM SM7 bronze; Nishad Kumar won his second gold, the men's high jump T47 (2.04m); India swept the men's discus F43/44/62/64 podium — Devendra Kumar gold, Rakesh Kumar silver, Pradeep Kumar bronze. Livemint put India sixth with 35 medals (9 gold, 11 silver, 15 bronze) at the end of day 2 of competition.

feed.text: Ranji Trophy: Uttar Pradesh beat Goa by 68 runs in Kanpur — teen spinner Kartik Yadav 5/37 as Goa, chasing 236, fold for 167.

feed.text: Asian Para Games: Himanshu Nandal wins men's 400m freestyle S11 bronze (5:10.91) — India on 24 medals (5G 8S 11B) per ANI. Sheetal Devi and Payal Nag meet China in the compound doubles final on 21 Oct, 05:55 IST.
